shots.scene: 欣欣拿着写字板站在实验室门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a clipboard with a blank checklist at the lab door and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们一起来找隐患！
overlay: 安全巡查：找找隐患在哪里

shots.scene: 放大镜扫过一间实验室，几处闪出问号
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass sweeps across a simple lab illustration, with small question marks popping up in several spots. No people.
shots.narration: 前面学过的，全都用得上。

shots.scene: 王老师给小研和阿杰各发一张空白清单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands each of the female graduate student and the young male student a clipboard with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 王老师给大家发了巡查清单。

shots.scene: 王老师眨眨眼，指向身后的实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator winks and points to the lab behind him.
shots.narration: 他悄悄在实验室里藏了几处隐患。

shots.scene: 小研拿着清单，放大镜照向实验台
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the checklist and looks at a lab bench through a large magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 巡查，就是主动去找隐患。
overlay: 安全巡查：主动找隐患

shots.scene: 隐患图标旁出现扳手和对勾
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon next to a wrench icon and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 找到问题，再想好怎么改。

shots.section_title: 定期巡查是安全管理的一部分
shots.scene: 日历上每隔一段画一个勾
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with check marks at regular intervals. No people.
shots.narration: 定期巡查，是安全管理的重要一环。
overlay: 定期巡查是安全管理的一部分

shots.section_title: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
shots.scene: 清单上五个空白方框
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with five empty boxes and five small icons: goggles, a fume hood, an eyewash station, a reagent bottle and a broom. No people.
shots.narration: 清单分五项，一项一项查。
overlay: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患

shots.section_title: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
shots.scene: 阿杰蹲下来仔细看台下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student crouches down to carefully check under a lab bench.
shots.narration: 隐患可能藏得很深，看仔细。

shots.scene: 找一找：老周穿短袖、没戴眼镜在台前
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at a lab bench without a lab coat, without safety glasses and without gloves, holding a beaker; a large question mark floats beside him.
shots.narration: 第一题：这位同事少了什么？
overlay: 查PPE：实验服、眼镜、手套

shots.scene: 揭晓：老周穿上实验服、戴眼镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The older man now wears a lab coat, safety glasses and gloves, with a green check mark beside him.
shots.narration: 实验服、安全眼镜、手套，一样不能少。

shots.section_title: 查着装：闭趾鞋、无首饰、扎头发
shots.scene: 小研的鞋、手腕、头发三处放大
shots.prompt_en: Three zoomed circles on the female graduate student: closed-toe shoes, bare wrists with no jewelry, and hair tied back.
shots.narration: 闭趾鞋、不戴首饰、长发扎起。
overlay: 查着装：闭趾鞋、无首饰、扎头发

shots.scene: 阿杰戴厚耐热手套打开灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears thick heat-resistant gloves while opening an autoclave lid.
shots.narration: 特殊操作，要换上专门的防护。
overlay: 特殊工作，特殊防护

shots.section_title: 查设备：检测合格、状态良好
shots.scene: 仪器上贴着空白的检测合格标签
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument with a blank inspection tag and a green check icon on its side. No people.
shots.narration: 设备要检测合格，状态良好。
overlay: 查设备：检测合格、状态良好

shots.section_title: 通风柜和生物安全柜不一样
shots.scene: 通风柜和生物安全柜并排
shots.prompt_en: A chemical fume hood and a biological safety cabinet standing side by side in a lab. No people.
shots.narration: 这两个柜子长得像，用途却不同。
overlay: 通风柜和生物安全柜不一样

shots.section_title: 通风柜：把有害蒸气排出去
shots.scene: 通风柜内蒸气被箭头抽走，经管道排出屋外
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with arrows showing vapor pulled away from the user up through a duct and out of the building. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜把有害蒸气抽走、排到室外。
overlay: 通风柜：把有害蒸气排出去

shots.section_title: 通风柜：把有害蒸气排出去
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里操作化学品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student handles a reagent bottle inside a fume hood with the sash lowered.
shots.narration: 做有毒化学品实验，就在通风柜里。

shots.scene: 柜侧空白合格标签被放大镜照着
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a blank certification label on the side of the fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 看看合格标签，确认检测过。
overlay: 看合格标签

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：过滤空气，人和样品都保护
shots.scene: 生物安全柜内气流经过滤器的示意
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet with arrows showing air passing through a filter layer and flowing down over the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜，空气经高效过滤。
overlay: 生物安全柜：过滤空气，人和样品都保护

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：过滤空气，人和样品都保护
shots.scene: 人和样品管各有一面盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram and a sample tube icon, each protected by a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 既保护人，也保护样品；也要有合格标签。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜里放挥发溶剂瓶的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a volatile solvent bottle inside a biological safety cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜，不能当通风柜用。
overlay: 两种柜子不能混用

shots.scene: 两个柜子各配对应的图标
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood paired with a reagent bottle icon, and a biological safety cabinet paired with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品进通风柜，生物样品进安全柜。

shots.scene: 找一找：洗眼器前堆着纸箱
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station and a safety shower in a lab, with cardboard boxes piled in front of the eyewash; a big question mark above. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：这里有什么问题？
overlay: 查应急设施：知道在哪

shots.scene: 揭晓：阿杰搬走纸箱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries the cardboard boxes away, leaving the eyewash station clear.
shots.narration: 洗眼器、冲淋器前，不能堆东西。
overlay: 应急设施前不堆东西

shots.scene: 洗眼器、冲淋器、灭火器、急救箱四个图标带定位针
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with location pins: an eyewash station, a safety shower, a fire extinguisher and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 这四样在哪，进门就要记住。

shots.section_title: 应急设施定期检查挂牌
shots.scene: 灭火器上挂着空白检查吊牌
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher with a blank inspection tag hanging on it. No people.
shots.narration: 应急设施要定期检查、挂好记录。
overlay: 应急设施定期检查挂牌

shots.section_title: 熟悉疏散路线，出口通畅
shots.scene: 楼层疏散图和安全出口标志
shots.prompt_en: A blank evacuation floor plan with arrow paths, next to an emergency exit sign above a clear door. No people.
shots.narration: 熟悉疏散路线，出口通畅有标志。
overlay: 熟悉疏散路线，出口通畅

shots.section_title: 查化学品：有标签、放整齐
shots.scene: 找一找：柜里一只瓶子没有标签，东倒西歪
shots.prompt_en: A chemical cabinet where most bottles are neatly lined up but one bottle has no label and lies on its side; a big question mark above. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：试剂柜里哪里不对？
overlay: 查化学品：有标签、放整齐

shots.section_title: 查化学品：有标签、放整齐
shots.scene: 揭晓：无标签瓶被拿出，其余排整齐
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes the unlabeled bottle into a tray and lines up the others neatly.
shots.narration: 化学品都要有标签，摆放整齐。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶空白标签和打开的空白文件夹
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a blank label and a red diamond GHS pictogram, next to an open blank binder. No people.
shots.narration: 危害、防护、储存，看标签，查SDS。
overlay: 标签和SDS里的安全信息

shots.section_title: 化学品和废物还要查什么
shots.scene: 试剂架分格，酸碱分开
shots.prompt_en: A divided storage shelf with acids and bases in separate compartments and a flammable cabinet beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 还要查：是否分类存放。
overlay: 化学品和废物还要查什么

shots.section_title: 化学品和废物还要查什么
shots.scene: 废液桶贴空白标签、盖紧，水槽打叉
shots.prompt_en: Labeled waste containers with tight caps, and a sink drain crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 废液是否分类、贴签、没倒下水道。

shots.section_title: 化学品和废物还要查什么
shots.scene: 双锁铁柜和空白台账
shots.prompt_en: A steel cabinet with two padlocks next to a blank ledger. No people.
shots.narration: 管控化学品，账物是否相符。

shots.scene: 找一找：插线板串着插线板，气瓶没绑
shots.prompt_en: A lab corner with a power strip plugged into another power strip and an unsecured gas cylinder standing alone; a big question mark above. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：这个角落有两处隐患。
overlay: 用电和气瓶也要查

shots.scene: 揭晓：插线板拆开，气瓶绑好、戴帽
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unplugs the chained power strip and straps the gas cylinder to the wall with its protective cap on.
shots.narration: 插线板不串接，气瓶固定好。

shots.section_title: 查内务：随手清理，通道畅通
shots.scene: 找一找：台面杂乱，椅子挡在过道
shots.prompt_en: A messy lab bench covered with used glassware and papers, and a chair left in the middle of the aisle; a big question mark above. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：内务哪里没做好？
overlay: 查内务：随手清理，通道畅通

shots.section_title: 查内务：随手清理，通道畅通
shots.scene: 揭晓：阿杰收拾台面，把椅子推进去
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tidies the bench, puts the glassware away and pushes the chair under the bench.
shots.narration: 自己的东西自己收，过道要畅通。

shots.scene: 实验台上的水杯和面包被红叉
shots.prompt_en: A coffee cup and a sandwich on a lab bench, crossed out with a red X, with a no eating or drinking sign. No people.
shots.narration: 饮料和食物，不能带进实验室。
overlay: 饮食不进实验室

shots.scene: 实验用的食品瓶贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A food sample jar used for an experiment with a blank label and a small flask icon on it. No people.
shots.narration: 实验用的食品，标明仅供实验。

shots.section_title: 实验室冰箱不放个人食品
shots.scene: 实验冰箱里放着饭盒，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An open lab refrigerator with a lunch box among sample racks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室冰箱，不放个人食品。
overlay: 实验室冰箱不放个人食品

shots.section_title: 实验室冰箱不放个人食品
shots.scene: 饭盒放进休息室的冰箱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his lunch box into a refrigerator in a staff break room outside the lab.
shots.narration: 吃的东西放在实验室外面。

shots.scene: 生物废物投入带生物危害标志的容器
shots.prompt_en: Used pipette tips going into a waste bin with a biohazard warning sign on it. No people.
shots.narration: 生物废物，放进有生物危害标志的容器。
overlay: 生物废物进专用容器

shots.section_title: 实验后清洁台面和设备
shots.scene: 小研喷洒消毒液擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sprays disinfectant on the bench and wipes it with paper towels, wearing gloves.
shots.narration: 每次实验后，清洁台面和设备。
overlay: 实验后清洁台面和设备

shots.scene: 碎玻璃放进带盖的防刺穿容器
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass pieces placed with tongs into a rigid puncture-proof container with a lid. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃等锐器，放进防刺穿容器。
overlay: 锐器进防刺穿容器

shots.scene: 三个容器：碎玻璃盒、感染性锐器盒、化学废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Three containers side by side: a box for clean broken glass, a sharps container with a biohazard warning sign, and a chemical waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 锐器也要分清楚污染类型。
overlay: 锐器分类收集

shots.scene: 徒手捡碎玻璃的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand picking up broken glass, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要徒手捡，用工具夹取。

shots.section_title: 国内高校：三级检查和日常自查
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层楼图标
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked building icons labeled with blank plates, connected by arrows from top to bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 高校实行三级安全检查。
overlay: 国内高校：三级检查和日常自查

shots.section_title: 国内高校：三级检查和日常自查
shots.scene: 小研每天下班前对照清单检查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank checklist while turning off equipment before leaving the lab in the evening.
shots.narration: 实验室自己还要天天自查。

shots.section_title: 发现隐患：记录、报告、整改、复查
shots.scene: 四步循环图：记录、报告、整改、复查
shots.prompt_en: A circular four-step arrow diagram with icons: a pen, a telephone, a wrench and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 发现隐患，要形成闭环。
overlay: 发现隐患：记录、报告、整改、复查

shots.section_title: 发现隐患：记录、报告、整改、复查
shots.scene: 王老师和老周在空白整改单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man sign a blank rectification form together.
shots.narration: 能马上改的立即改，改不了的报告。

shots.section_title: 清单只是起点，动手去查
shots.scene: 阿杰和小研交还写满勾的清单
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student hand back clipboards full of check marks to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 清单只是起点，平时也要多看多查。
overlay: 清单只是起点，动手去查

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现五项清单图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five floating icons: goggles, a fume hood, an eyewash station, a reagent bottle and a broom.
shots.narration: 防护、设备、应急、化学品、内务。
overlay: 小结

shots.scene: 两个柜子和应急设施图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood, a biological safety cabinet and a clear eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子不混用，应急设施不堵。

shots.scene: 插线板、气瓶、废液桶图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a single power strip, a strapped gas cylinder and labeled waste containers, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 用电气瓶、分类存放和废物都要查。

shots.scene: 循环箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow icon around a warning triangle that turns into a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 发现隐患，整改闭环。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着写满勾的清单挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a clipboard full of green check marks and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 人人会找隐患，实验室才安全！
